title: Grothendieck Brown localization retract
statement: Under the hypotheses of `CategoryTheory.grothendieckDerived_cohomological_isRepresentable`, the underlying set-valued functor is a natural retract of the universe-lifted Yoneda functor of some object of the derived category: there exist E : DerivedCategory A and a `Retract` from `(H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat) ⋙ uliftFunctor` to `uliftYoneda E`.

source.place: injectives-lemma-brown, first two paragraphs through the direct-summand conclusion

proof.text: Apply the Gabriel-Popescu localization and compact-generator Brown representability to H after the exact left adjoint. Complete the unit triangle, use vanishing after localization to obtain a retraction, and transport it through the localization adjunction. The resulting natural split maps are the asserted retract.

lean.statement:
theorem grothendieckDerived_brown_retract
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vH} (DerivedCategory A)]
    (H : (DerivedCategory A)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{vH}) [H.IsHomological]
    (hH : ∀ I : Type (max w vA vH), PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete I) H) :
    ∃ E : DerivedCategory A,
      Nonempty (Retract (H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat ⋙ uliftFunctor.{w})
        (uliftYoneda.{vH}.obj E))
